title: Free Night Awards Reissue Terms Schedule
content:
The reissue terms of the Free Night Awards set, for each award type, whether an award released after its expiry date because the hotel relocated the reservation is reissued, how long a reissued award is valid from its reissue date, and how many times one award may be reissued.

| Award type | Reissued when released after its expiry date because the hotel relocated the reservation | Replacement validity (calendar months from the reissue date) | Times an award may be reissued |
|---|---|---|---|
| 25K Free Night Award | Yes | 3 | 1 |
| 35K Free Night Award | Yes | 3 | 1 |
| 40K Free Night Award | Yes | 3 | 1 |
| 50K Free Night Award | Yes | 3 | 1 |
| 85K Free Night Award | Yes | 6 | 1 |
| Any Hotel Free Night Award | Yes | 6 | 1 |

### Points of the schedule

**Which figure is the replacement validity?** The replacement validity is the number of calendar months a reissued award is valid from its reissue date, read from the row of the award type. It is 3 months for the 25K, 35K, 40K and 50K Free Night Awards and 6 months for the 85K Free Night Award and the Any Hotel Free Night Award.

**How many reissues may one award have?** One, for every award type.

**Is any award type outside the reissue term?** No. For all six award types an award released after its expiry date because the hotel relocated the reservation is reissued.
